title.en: A run is refused before anything heats when no person is present

goal.en: The hub dry-runs every request against the device before accepting it. This counter arm has no hob and may not cut unattended, so a request with nobody present is refused at the first node, and the refusal says why.

note.en: The device: three operations (cut, crack, transfer), one vision sensor, presence detection and a stop control.
Send the request with humanPresent false. The answer is an ExecutionStatus in state refused with a reason, the node and a detail; nothing was heated or moved.
Stop is never refused, even for a run that never started: the hub returns the final status unchanged.

outcome.en: You have a refusal with reason, node and detail, which is the standard's first promise: check before heat. Next: scenarios 046 to 048 show the other refusal reasons a hub applies before the dry run.
